invariants.rationale: The method expects a tintColor, and likely operates correctly only when tintColor is non-null.
set() is called on this.tintColor; a NullPointerException would occur if it were null.
It's common for set methods to copy values rather than reference assign; likely tintColor and this.tintColor are different Color objects.
After set(), the layer's tint color is equal in value to the parameter tintColor.
